content_sections.heading: EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026 – Post Details
content_sections.text: EdCIL has advertised 13 positions across six technical posts for the KVS PMU. The number of positions and posts are indicative and subject to change, upgrade, or downgrade without notice.

content_sections.heading: EdCIL KVS PMU Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Prescribed qualifications and experience must be acquired on or before 31.07.2026, from Government-recognized institutions. Candidates must have strong oral and written communication skills and good working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, and PowerPoint. Candidates working in Government/PSU/Autonomous bodies must route their application through proper channel, if their department rules require it.

rows.minimum_qualification: B.Arch. from a recognized university, registered with the Council of Architecture (COA)
rows.minimum_experience: 10 years in institutional/school building design, master planning, and statutory approvals

rows.minimum_qualification: B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute
rows.minimum_experience: 10 years in construction supervision, project management, and vetting of DPRs/Estimates (Government project experience preferred)

rows.minimum_qualification: B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized university/institute
rows.minimum_experience: 7 years in Building Construction and vetting of DPRs/Estimates

rows.minimum_qualification: 2/3-year Diploma or B.Tech/B.E. in Civil Engineering from a recognized institute
rows.minimum_experience: 3 years (Diploma holders) or 1 year (B.Tech) in civil construction, site measurements, and daily progress reporting

rows.minimum_qualification: 2/3-year Diploma in Civil Engineering/Architectural Assistantship, or ITI Drafting certification with certified AutoCAD & Revit/3D Max course
rows.minimum_experience: 2 years hands-on experience in 2D working drawings, 3D rendering, and BIM modeling

rows.minimum_qualification: B.Tech (CS/IT)/BCA/B.Sc (IT) with a strong background in Statistics/Data Analytics
rows.minimum_experience: 2 years managing MIS portals, data analytics, dashboard monitoring, and report generation (Excel, PowerPoint)

content_sections.heading: EdCIL KVS PMU Age Limit
content_sections.text: Age is reckoned as on 31.07.2026. No age relaxation is mentioned in the notification. Before submitting the application, candidates are advised to verify that they meet the required age criteria. Use our Age Calculator to calculate your exact age as per the official cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: EdCIL KVS PMU Salary
content_sections.text: Remuneration is on a consolidated monthly basis, inclusive of all allowances, and varies by post: The engagement is purely contractual for one year, extendable by a further year based on project requirement and individual performance.

content_sections.heading: EdCIL KVS PMU Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is based on academic/professional qualifications and relevant experience. An Interview may also be conducted, depending on the total number of eligible applicants. Merely meeting the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. A waiting list will be prepared for each post category; if a selected candidate does not join, or a consequential vacancy arises, candidates from the waiting list may be offered the position based on experience and qualifications. Documents proving qualification, experience, and age must be produced in original at the time of interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual hiring drive by EdCIL (India) Limited, under Advertisement No. EdCIL/TSG/KVS/PMU/2026-01 dated 02.09.2026, to engage technical manpower for a Project Monitoring Unit set up at KVS Headquarters, New Delhi, for infrastructure project monitoring.

faq.question: Q2. How many positions are available in EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 positions are open: 1 Architect, 1 Senior Engineer (Civil), 2 Engineer (Civil), 6 Junior Engineer (Civil), 1 AutoCAD/Revit Operator, and 2 Young Professional (Data Management & Web Monitoring).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of online applications is 15.09.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for EdCIL KVS PMU posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by post - B.Arch (COA-registered) for Architect, B.Tech/B.E. Civil for Senior Engineer/Engineer, Diploma or B.Tech Civil for Junior Engineer, a Diploma/ITI with AutoCAD-Revit certification for the CAD Operator post, and B.Tech(CS/IT)/BCA/BSc(IT) for the Young Professional post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: As on 31.07.2026, the maximum age is 45 years for Architect and Senior Engineer (Civil), 40 years for Engineer (Civil), and 35 years for Junior Engineer (Civil), AutoCAD/Revit Operator, and Young Professional posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No fee is required to apply for any of the posts.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply online through the Resource Pool Portal at tsgrecruitment.edcil.co.in between 02.09.2026 and 15.09.2026, submitting a separate application for each post applied to.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for EdCIL KVS PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is based on academic/professional qualifications and relevant experience, followed by an Interview if conducted, depending on the number of eligible applicants. A waiting list is also prepared for each post.
